jobs.name: indexed_join
jobs.sql: SELECT a.label, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1

jobs.name: join_residual
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id,b.id FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.bucket=a.bucket AND abs(b.score-a.score)<50 WHERE a.id<$1 AND b.id<$1 ORDER BY a.id,b.id

jobs.name: join_text_predicate
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id,b.id FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id AND length(b.label)>=4 WHERE a.id=$1 AND b.id=$1 ORDER BY a.id,b.id

jobs.name: join_text_projection
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id,lower(b.label) FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id WHERE a.id=$1 AND b.id=$1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: join_integer_outputs
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id,abs(b.score-a.score) FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id WHERE a.id=$1 AND b.id=$1 AND abs(b.score)>=0 ORDER BY abs(a.id)

jobs.name: left_builtin
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id,lower(c.label) FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id LEFT JOIN items c ON c.id=b.id AND abs(c.score)>=0 AND c.bucket<>3 WHERE a.id=$1 AND b.id=$1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: function_fallback
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id,repeat(b.label,1) FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id WHERE a.id=$1 AND b.id=$1 ORDER BY a.id
